attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter & half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of the extract of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company published a newspaper advertisement on November 15, 2026, in the Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshdeep. The filing was submitted to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 16, 2026. The document includes financial data tables and notes in Hindi and English. The Managing Director, Vikram Bhawanishankar Sharma, signed the letter. The notice confirms compliance with Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. No other corporate actions or resolutions are mentioned in this specific filing.

attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a revised press release dated November 16, 2026, titled " Supreme Infrastructure reported Q2FY26 Revenue . ".
voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited submitted a press release titled Supreme Infra’s Q2 Marks a Strong Financial Revival to BSE and NSE on November 16, 2026. The media release highlights the company's financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations increased 114.8% year-on-year to 2,900.42 lakh rupees. Total income rose 130.3% to 3,356.27 lakh rupees. The company reported a profit after tax of 367.79 lakh rupees, marking its first profitable quarter post-Scheme. Finance costs declined 94.7% quarter-on-quarter to 313.06 lakh rupees. The Composite Scheme was completed on October 31, 2026, resolving legacy debt issues. The company is now debt-free with positive net worth. Auditors have discontinued the going concern emphasis. More than 4 crore rupees were recovered from old debtors during the quarter.

voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited submitted a press release and investor presentation regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 2,900.42 lakh, an increase of 114.8% year-on-year. Total income rose 130.3% to 3,356.27 lakh. The company recorded a profit after tax of 367.79 lakh, marking its first profitable quarter post-Scheme. Finance costs declined 94.7% quarter-on-quarter to 313.06 lakh. The Composite Scheme was completed on October 31, 2026. Net worth moved from negative to positive territory. More than 4 crore was recovered from old debtors during the July to September 2026 quarter. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited Board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Independent auditors Borkar and Muzumdar issued a modified review report. The auditors could not comment on adjustments for trade receivables and other current assets amounting to 75,648.58 lakhs due to long outstanding periods. They also could not comment on non-current investments and trade receivables from erstwhile subsidiary Supreme Infrastructure BOT Private Limited amounting to 1,42,556.84 lakhs and 2,221.36 lakhs, which are under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. Similar qualifications apply to investments and receivables from Supreme Panvel Indapur Tollways Private Limited totaling 15,677.22 lakhs, 3,814.98 lakhs, and 3,201.67 lakhs, which are also under CIRP. Additionally, the auditors noted an understatement of loss by 17,346.43 lakhs for the quarter and 28,645.53 lakhs for the half year due to non-accrual of interest on reversed amounts.

attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has informed the Exchange about Shareholders meeting held on Thursday, November 12, 2026
voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited held its 43rd Annual General Meeting on November 12, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. via video conferencing. The meeting concluded at 11:44 A.M. with 117 members present. Resolutions placed before members included adopting audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026, re-appointing Pankaj Prakash Sharma as a director, and appointing Dr. Prabhakant as an independent director. Voting was conducted electronically. The final results are pending the receipt of the Scrutinizer's Report. The company will declare the results and communicate them to the stock exchanges in due course. The outcomes will also be published on the company and stock exchange websites.
